text:
Thank you to the team for completing this month’s operations for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. The desk maintained steady service continuity, with clear handoffs between planning, welfare checks, and passenger preparation.

Service flow remained consistent across the month. The senior coordinator supported daily routing and exception handling, while the welfare coordinator ensured each remy-ready case met comfort requirements before boarding. The welcome team maintained calm passenger guidance, and staff recorded all service changes in the desk ledger so follow-ups could be completed without gaps.

For Moonwake, the cabin setting was verified in line with standard welfare planning and cabin readiness checks <<FACT F042>>. Staff used approved observation notes to confirm pet handling procedures were applied during turnarounds, and the welfare coordinator logged any variance for review. Where adjustments were needed, the desk implemented them promptly to preserve schedule integrity.

Traveler communications were handled with a neutral, practical tone. Where Milan Ibrahim and Hana Larsen required additional guidance, the welcome team provided clear expectations for documentation review and boarding pacing, and the desk ensured consistency across all interaction points.

Looking ahead, the desk will prioritize comfort-focused readiness, tighten handoff timing between teams, and complete end-of-cycle ledger reconciliation to support smooth operations next month. Continued discipline will help us maintain safe, predictable service for every traveler.
